visual_action: A montage of video clips. It begins with musician Beyoncé smiling behind a podium bearing the Seal of the President of the United States. It then cuts to wide shots of a massive, cheering stadium crowd at night, holding up phone lights. The video then shows Vice President Kamala Harris on a stage, smiling as she embraces another woman, and then shakes hands with Beyoncé.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Vice President Kamala Harris is shown on stage smiling and shaking hands with Beyoncé. Her name also appears in the on-screen text: 'HARRIS-WALZ EDITION'.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: His name appears in the on-screen text 'HARRIS-WALZ EDITION'.

cast.name: Beyoncé
cast.evidence: Beyoncé is shown prominently at the beginning and end of the video, and the entire post is framed around her and her viral 'Mute Challenge'.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account.

spoken_summary: A clip from Beyoncé's song "ENERGY" plays, featuring the lyrics "Look around, everybody on mute," followed by a dramatic pause in the music, which then resumes.
audio_music: The video uses a high-energy clip from Beyoncé's song "ENERGY." The music builds, then cuts out for several seconds for the "mute" part of the song, creating a dramatic pause, before resuming triumphantly with crowd cheers mixed in. The effect is to generate hype and associate a feeling of collective power with the politicians shown.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different scenes of Beyoncé, a concert crowd, and Kamala Harris.
central_claim: The Harris-Walz campaign has the same powerful, popular, and unified energy as a Beyoncé concert and is supported by this major cultural icon.
intended_effect: To generate excitement for the Harris-Walz campaign by associating it with Beyoncé and a viral cultural moment, making viewers feel that supporting the ticket is being part of a cool and powerful movement.
